process.title: Four steps, no surprises
process.subtitle: We work with a contract and a fixed price. If anything changes, we talk before we touch your garden.

step1.title: You reach out
step1.description: Tell us what you need and the approximate size of your yard. We reply within 24 business hours.

step2.title: We visit your yard
step2.description: We look at the terrain, measure, and tell you what it needs — and what it doesn't. No cost.

step3.title: Fixed quote
step3.description: A written price, with materials and timeline. What you sign is what you pay.

step4.title: Work & follow-up
step4.description: Same crew on every visit, photos when we're done, and a direct contact for anything you need.

pricing.title: Maintenance plans
pricing.disclaimer: Ballpark prices for yards up to 5,000 sq ft. Exact quote after the visit, always free.
